verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs explicitly describe built-in multi-currency support for both payments and payouts ('customers purchase in their local currency and letting you get paid in yours'), backed by merchant-of-record tax compliance across 200+ countries and payout reconciliation reports that itemize gross, taxes, fees, and 'transaction and balance currencies' for transparent FX/settlement tracking. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the FX conversion rate/margin methodology, and independent third-party confirmation of settlement transparency (community evidence only covers VAT/support quality, not FX mechanics).
